live_hider.title: StreamShield
live_hider.overlay.hide_on_failure: Hide selected HUD locally if overlay is unavailable
live_hider.overlay.hide_on_failure.toolt: When the overlay is not ready or fails, hide the selected HUD components in your own game too. Off by default. This can hide health and hotbar information while you play.
live_hider.preflight.title: Pre-stream check
live_hider.preflight.open_hint: Opening the check saves your current edits. Its status updates live; verify the OBS preview before going live.
live_hider.preflight.manual_check: Readiness is local to StreamShield. READY does not verify what OBS records. Check the OBS Game Capture preview and a short recording before streaming.
live_hider.preflight.status.ready: Ready locally — OBS preview still needs checking
live_hider.preflight.status.failed: Failed — selected HUD may appear in capture
live_hider.preflight.fallback: Hide selected HUD locally when overlay is unavailable: %s
live_hider.preflight.fallback_hint: When enabled, this fallback also removes selected HUD information from your own view. It does not verify OBS, hide unselected components, or sanitize the world view.
live_hider.preflight.components_hint: Saved HUD choices, updated live. Auto-hide removes the component from your own view while another GUI is open; close menus when comparing in-game and OBS views.
live_hider.preflight.privacy: Name anonymization: %s / Chat-input sanitization: %s / Text redaction: %s
live_hider.preflight.preview_steps: Compare game and OBS: open chat, TAB and a scoreboard, then check health, hotbar and experience with menus closed. Repeat after changing capture settings, resizing or reloading resources.
live_hider.preflight.diagnostic_hint: Safe diagnostics include build/runtime versions, overlay status/codes, and fixed boolean settings only. They omit chat, names, servers, rule text, skin data, paths and logs. No report is sent automatically.
live_hider.preflight.copied: Safe diagnostics copied to your clipboard.
live_hider.preflight.exported: Saved in the game folder's streamshield-diagnostics directory: %s
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.live_hide: StreamShield - A stream-safe display rewriter and OBS overlay. It anonymizes player names, item names, scoreboards and HUD elements so your stream never leaks sensitive information.
live_hider.redact_enabled.tooltip: Replace matched words with the replacement text wherever they appear (chat, scoreboard, etc.).
live_hider.redact_replacement.tooltip: The text substituted in place of a matched word.
live_hider.auto_grab_server.tooltip: Automatically redact the current server's IP and name when shown.
live_hider.redact_preset.tooltip: Include the small built-in list for common invite/contact leaks. Server IP/name is handled separately.
live_hider.redact_strict_preset.tooltip: Also enable the broad profanity/sensitive-content list. It can hide ordinary chat words.
live_hider.redact_words.hint: Click "Add" below, then type a word in the box and press Enter. One per line; Chinese or English.
live_hider.redact_words.tooltip: Extra words/phrases to redact, one per line.
live_hider.skin_mode.tooltip: OFF keeps real skins. STEVE makes everyone render as Steve. CUSTOM assigns a substitute from your configured account pool.
live_hider.skin_other_mode.tooltip: ORIGINAL keeps their real skin. STEVE uses Steve. CUSTOM uses the one skin below. RANDOM assigns a skin from the pool.
live_hider.skin.desc: Choose independently for yourself and other players: ORIGINAL keeps the skin, STEVE uses Steve, CUSTOM uses one fixed replacement, and RANDOM uses the pool below.
live_hider.skin_source.tooltip: MOJANG uses official account skins. LITTLESKIN and ELYBY use their public PNG endpoints. URL_TEMPLATE uses the HTTPS template below.
live_hider.skin.refresh.tooltip: Saves current skin edits and redraws this page so only fields for the selected source are shown.
live_hider.skin_url_template.tooltip: Only for URL_TEMPLATE. Must be an HTTPS PNG endpoint containing {name}; for example: https://example.com/skins/{name}.png. No tokens or credentials are sent.
live_hider.skin_local_folder.tooltip: Only for LOCAL_FOLDER. Direct PNG files in this folder form the random pool. They must be 64x64 and no larger than 1 MiB; subfolders are ignored.
live_hider.skin.local_status: Local folder: %s usable PNG skin(s) found.
live_hider.skin_self_mode.tooltip: ORIGINAL keeps your real skin. STEVE uses Steve. CUSTOM uses the one skin below. RANDOM assigns a skin from the pool.
live_hider.skin_custom.tooltip: Used by CUSTOM. Enter an account ID for online sources, or a direct PNG filename such as StreamShield2.png for LOCAL_FOLDER.
live_hider.skin_pool.hint: Add account IDs below (letters, digits, underscores; 3–16 characters). CUSTOM assigns them to players with repeats allowed.
live_hider.skin_pool.tooltip: Account IDs used by the selected source. An empty pool or failed lookup falls back to Steve.
live_hider.anonymize_names.tooltip: Replace real player names with an anonymous template.
live_hider.name_digits.tooltip: Number of digits in the anonymized suffix.
live_hider.self_name_mode.tooltip: HIDE hides your name; CUSTOM uses a fixed name; OWN shows your real ID; RANDOM randomizes it (tied to name anonymization — if anonymization is off, your real name is shown).
live_hider.self_custom_name.tooltip: The name to show for yourself in CUSTOM mode. Supports § color/format codes and & aliases; use && for a literal ampersand.
live_hider.sanitize_chat.tooltip: Anonymize player names in the chat input field. Works independently of the global name-anonymization display setting.
live_hider.normalize_items.tooltip: Renamed items display their localized vanilla name instead of a custom name. This only changes your client display.
live_hider.scoreboard.desc: Scoreboard chain rules: each rule maps a word; the result of one feeds the next. Expand a rule to edit, toggle it on/off.
live_hider.scoreboard.actions_hint: Adding, deleting, or moving a rule saves all current edits before this page refreshes.
live_hider.scoreboard.disclaimer: Note: scoreboard rewriting works on most servers, but some servers may not be changeable.
live_hider.scoreboard.enabled_group.tool: When off, the whole chain of scoreboard rules is disabled.
live_hider.scoreboard.key.tooltip: The word to match (Chinese or English).
live_hider.scoreboard.replacement.toolti: The text substituted for the matched word.
live_hider.overlay.desc: Enabled HUD components are redirected away from the OBS capture while remaining visible to you. Auto-hide also hides a component from your own screen while another GUI is open.
live_hider.overlay.hide_all_screens.tool: Hide the entire screen when a gui is open.
live_hider.overlay.show_test_icon.toolti: Show a small test icon to verify that the overlay routing is working.
live_hider.overlay.debug_menu.autohide.t: Hide the debug overlay when another screen is open.
live_hider.overlay.chat.autohide.tooltip: Hide the chat log when another screen is open.
live_hider.overlay.chat_bar.autohide.too: Hide the chat input bar when another screen is open.
Hide the player list when another screen is open.
live_hider.overlay.subtitles.autohide.to: Hide subtitles when another screen is open.
Hide the sidebar scoreboard when another screen is open.
live_hider.overlay.actionbar.autohide.to: Hide the action bar when another screen is open.
live_hider.overlay.title_subtitle.toolti: Hide the large title / subtitle text.
live_hider.overlay.title_subtitle.autohi: Hide the title / subtitle when another screen is open.
live_hider.overlay.effects.autohide.tool: Hide potion effects when another screen is open.
live_hider.overlay.main_hud.autohide.too: Hide the main HUD when another screen is open.
